thesis: The speakers argue that the next two decades of leadership require blending digital and physical capabilities, noting that incumbents must understand software impacts while disruptors must grasp the complexities of logistics and supply chains. They contend that digitization is necessary but not sufficient, and that most companies cannot execute everything themselves, requiring leaders to decide which core competencies to own versus which aspects of the ecosystem to influence through partnerships.
